# Fixtures

Frozen test fixtures consumed by the Rust test suite. These files are
**not** regenerated by any script; they are versioned byte-stable inputs.

| Directory | Consumed by | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `artifact-parity/` | `crates/seattrellis-io/tests/artifact_parity.rs` | artifact compare/restore semantics |
| `cli-goldens/` | `crates/seattrellis-cli` (stdout+exit golden tests) | CLI output contract |
| `parity/goldens/` | `crates/seattrellis-io/tests/artifact_parity.rs` | cross-version artifact goldens |
| `roster-mapping/` | `crates/seattrellis-io/tests/roster_mapping_parity.rs` | roster header-mapping heuristics |

Historical note: the `parity/goldens` corpus was originally recorded against
the retired Python v1.9.0 oracle. Since v2.0.0 the oracle, its generator
scripts and the differential CI jobs have been removed; the goldens remain
as frozen regression inputs only.
